name: Westminster Veterans Day Ceremony
eligibility_quote: Veterans Day Ceremony, Wednesday, November 11, 2026, 10:00 AM to 11:00 AM (City of Westminster calendar).
limits: Free. City administrative offices are closed. Parking is not described.
offer: The City of Westminster's Veterans Day ceremony at the Armed Forces Tribute Garden, 10-11 AM. The Denver Gazette lists a flag presentation, live music, a keynote speaker, the reading of new brick honorees' names and free coffee.

sources.publisher: City of Westminster (Parks, Recreation and Libraries calendar)

notes: The city's own calendar gives 10:00-11:00 AM at 6001 W 104th Ave. The Denver Gazette prints 6601 W 104th Ave, a typo: the city's Tribute Garden page and OpenStreetMap both put the garden at 6001. The 2025 and 2024 ceremonies were also at 10 AM. The phone is the Parks, Recreation and Libraries office from the city's Tribute Garden page. Gazette details (music, keynote, coffee) are B-level.

name: Wings Over the Rockies Air & Space Museum
eligibility_quote: Veterans enjoy free admission! Valid military ID at check-in; no advance ticket.
limits: Family and guests buy tickets online in advance. Guard, Reserve and retirees are not named; the page says veterans and active duty.
offer: Free museum admission for veterans and active-duty military, 10 AM-5 PM, with a military ID at check-in and no advance ticket.

sources.publisher: Wings Over the Rockies Air & Space Museum

notes: From the museum's own homepage Veterans Day banner, read 11 Nov. The page gives no street address and no general phone; the address is the museum's own as listed by the City of Aurora and matches the OpenStreetMap pin. Adult ticket price not published, so est_value_usd is null. The $20 Aurora Veterans Salute is held here on Thu 12 Nov (see extras).

name: Blue Island Oyster Bar
eligibility_quote: On Wednesday, November 11, veterans can receive a complimentary entree of their choice, valued up to $40, along with a nonalcoholic beverage.
limits: Entree up to $40 plus a nonalcoholic drink (no mocktails). Dine-in, select Veterans Day menu, one per person; tip and tax extra.
offer: A free entree (up to $40) and a nonalcoholic drink for veterans on 11 Nov at both Cherry Creek (11:30 AM-9 PM) and Lone Tree (11 AM-9 PM).
notes: Shucking Good Hospitality. Blue Island's own page was not found, so B: Mile High on the Cheap and the Gazette (both 10 Nov 2026) and the Cherry Creek North district listing carry it. Cherry Creek 11:30-9 is from that listing; Lone Tree 11-9 and the addresses come from event listings via search results, not the restaurant. An older Westword item showed 11:30-10 PM, so confirm closing time. The Cherry Creek pin is the OpenStreetMap node for the restaurant (OSM files it at 200 Columbine St, the 2nd Ave corner); the listing address is 2625 E 2nd Ave.

name: Ash and Agave
eligibility_quote: Veterans get a free entree (up to $35) and a non-alcoholic beverage on Nov. 11.
limits: Entree up to $35 plus a nonalcoholic drink (no mocktails per KOOL 105). Dine-in; hours not published.
offer: A free entree (up to $35) and a nonalcoholic drink for veterans at Ash and Agave, Cherry Creek Shopping Center (lower level near Neiman Marcus).
notes: Shucking Good Hospitality's Mexican restaurant (opened spring 2026) in the old California Pizza Kitchen space. Hours not published anywhere, so hours_local is blank. The pin is the Cherry Creek Shopping Center node, not the restaurant (not mapped in OSM). No restaurant page found.

name: Thirsty Lion
eligibility_quote: Those who have served can get a free entree.
limits: One entree from a short list (cheeseburger, spicy fried chicken sandwich, French dip, fish and chips, Tuscan Romano chicken or Southwest smoked chicken salad, per Westword). In-store.
offer: A free entree for veterans and active duty at Thirsty Lion, Union Station (open 11 AM-10 PM Wednesdays).

sources.publisher: Thirsty Lion (location page: hours and phone only)

notes: The offer is in the Gazette (10 Nov 2026); the entree list is Westword's via a search result, since Westword blocked a direct read. The restaurant's own page gives hours and phone but no Veterans Day text.

name: Salt Water Social
eligibility_quote: One complimentary entree from select options with the purchase of a starter.

offer: A free select entree with the purchase of a starter, for veterans, active duty, reservists and Gold Star families, through 11 Nov.
notes: Own page, read 11 Nov: Nov 9-11, 2026, valid ID or proof of employment/service. The page gives no hours, phone or address; 201 Columbine St is from Mile High on the Cheap. The pin is the OpenStreetMap address node for that building (the restaurant is not mapped). Entree prices not checked, so est_value_usd is null.

name: The Rendezvous at Heather Gardens
address: 2888 S Heather Gardens Way, Aurora, CO 80014
eligibility_quote: Veterans pay $8 for breakfast-for-dinner, 5-8 p.m. Other guests pay $11-$16. Reservations required.
limits: Reservations required (720-282-3443). Veterans pay $8 (a discounted price, not free); other guests pay $11-$16.

name: Westminster Golf: Legacy Ridge
eligibility_quote: One free round for veterans and active military with valid ID. Cart costs extra. (KOOL 105)
limits: Green fee only; cart extra. KOOL says Legacy Ridge or Walnut Creek. The City of Westminster's golf pages found do not mention it.
offer: One free round of golf at Legacy Ridge or Walnut Creek for veterans and active military, per KOOL 105. Not found on the City of Westminster's golf pages.
notes: KOOL 105 (10 Nov 2026) only. City golf pages in search results show no Veterans Day free round (only a 2025 resident free day and PGA HOPE). Tee-time availability and hours unknown. Walnut Creek (10555 W Westmoor Dr, 80021) is 1.1 km outside circle 6. The phone is the Legacy Ridge shop from a search result. Call first.

name: The Melting Pot
eligibility_quote: Veterans get a complimentary four-course meal with purchase of another regular-price four-course meal. Military ID required.
limits: A second regular-price four-course meal must be bought; not combinable; tax, gratuity and a 3% heart-of-house service charge extra
offer: A free four-course fondue meal for a veteran when a second diner buys a regular-price four-course meal, at The Melting Pot, Littleton.
notes: Graded B, not A: the restaurant's own Littleton page (read 11 Nov) has address, phone (303) 794-5666 and regular hours (Wednesday 11am-10pm) but no Veterans Day offer and no holiday-hours entry for it. The offer is from KOOL 105 (10 Nov 2026) only. Hours are the regular Wednesday hours, not a holiday notice. 3% service charge not verified. Call first. Grade A: the restaurant's own events page carries the 2026 terms (chain research, 11 Nov 2026).

name: STK Steakhouse
eligibility_quote: Order any starter and choose one of four STK signatures at no charge. Valid November 9-11, 2026.
limits: Dine-in only; tax and gratuity not included; cannot be combined. Four entrees: Steak Frites, Maple Rubbed Salmon, Free Range Chicken, Mushroom & Truffle Tagliatelle. Reservations recommended. Gold Star family members each get one entree per starter bought.
offer: A free entree (Steak Frites, salmon, chicken or tagliatelle) with the purchase of any starter, for veterans, active duty, reservists and Gold Star families, through 11 Nov.
notes: STK's own page, read 11 Nov: Valid November 9-11, 2026, at participating U.S. locations (not Las Vegas); Denver is only a link to its location page and is not named as participating. Mile High on the Cheap (10 Nov 2026) lists STK at 1550 Market St with the offer; STK's Denver location page returned 404, so no hours or phone. Mile High lists first responders as eligible; STK's page does not. The pin is the STK Denver node in OpenStreetMap.
